reviews.text: I haven't had the opportunity to get a grooming appointment because they're always unavailable and don't even respond to messages, or don't reply until weeks later. Even reaching them to schedule an appointment is impossible. For me, that's already a huge sign of unreliability and doesn't encourage me to try again. I understand they might be busy, but so are other people who work and want to fit grooming into their other commitments. Not responding or not calling back is neither acceptable nor respectful to the client.

Simona is a wonderful person. One of my dogs has a problem, but we found a solution to shear her without any trauma. Thank you so much. You can tell she loves animals and that her care comes from the heart.

Marco and Simona are always available and ready to welcome us with kindness and professionalism. During the washing and drying process, they patiently pamper the dogs, making them feel calm and protected.
Owners can rest assured: every four-legged friend is in excellent hands here.
My dog, who is a bit of a coward, always leaves happy and smelling good.
Very good and helpful... we will definitely be back
